email or password error: Wrong email or password. A banned account or one whose email is not yet verified can't log in either.
2fa code error: Wrong email, password or two-step verification code.
2fa code required: This account uses two-step verification. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
2fa code format: The two-step verification code is 6 digits.
2fa code hint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
captcha failed: The human check failed. Reload the page and try again.
network error: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
server error: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
please input a valid email: Please enter a valid email address.
session expired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
go to gravatar to change avatar: Go to Gravatar to change avatar
homepage tips: Current users' homepage. It must be start with <1>http://</1> or <1>https://</1>.
password tips: It's recommended to use a mixed style of special characters, letters and numbers to increase system security.
password again tips: Please confirm your password, consistent with the password entered above.
nickname and homepage are required: Both nickname and personal homepage are required fields.
delete one confirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{nick}}'s comment?
delete multiple confirm: Are you sure you want to delete these comments?
author: Author
import clear data confirm: Notice! All current data will be overwrited by importing data, do you really want to continue?
close 2fa confirm: Two-step verification can greatly improve the security of your account. Are you sure to turn it off?
2fa description 1: Two-step verification, as can be seen from the name, "two-step" is the focus of 2FA, and 2FA in a broad sense refers to providing a variety of solutions to complete user authorization authentication.
2fa description 2: After enabling two-step verification, to log in to the background of the system, in addition to the user name and password, additional tokens must be provided, which can greatly improve the security of the system.
open app and scan qrcode: Open the Two-step verification app and scan the QR code below
you will receive an email which contains: You'll receive an email which contains a link to create new password.
find password success! please go to your: The reset password email has been sent successfully, please check it in your mailbox!
find password error! try again later: Failed to send reset password email, please try again later!
You can't set yourself to be guest!: You can't set yourself to be guest!
new version tips: New version @waline/vercel@{{version}} published, please upgrade it! Goto FAQ to find How to upgrade it.
leancloud warning: Leancloud will cease external services soon. If you are using it, please migration your comment data as soon as possible.
delete user confirm: Are you sure to delete this user? Verify user will be deleted directly, while other users will be forbidden to login.
please input 2fa code: Please input the two-step verification code
or use password: or use your email and password
passkeys description: Sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello, your phone or a security key instead of a password. A passkey sign-in doesn't ask for the two-step verification code: the passkey already proves both that it's you and that you hold the device.
passkey timeout: The passkey prompt timed out. Try again.
passkey unknown: That passkey isn't set up for this site. Use your password, then add it again from Settings.
passkey not configured: Passkeys aren't set up on this server. Sign in with your password.
passkey expired: The sign-in request expired. Try again.
passkey rate limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
passkey forbidden: This passkey belongs to an account that can't sign in here.
passkey failed: The passkey couldn't be verified. Try again or use your password.
passkey register failed: The passkey couldn't be added. Try again.
passkey exists: This device already has a passkey for this site.
passkey env invalid: PASSKEYS is set in Vercel but couldn't be read. Paste the value exactly as copied (it starts with [ and ends with ]), then redeploy.
no passkeys: No passkeys are set up yet.
passkey created: Passkey created. It starts working after one more step:
passkey step vercel: In Vercel, open the project, then Settings → Environment Variables, and set PASSKEYS to it, replacing the old value.
passkey step redeploy: Redeploy. The new passkey works once that deployment is live.
passkey remove hint: Passkeys live in the PASSKEYS environment variable. To remove one, delete its entry there in Vercel and redeploy.
